units.source_text: 由于蚕房兼作戏棚，所以二楼设有不怎么样的观众席。

en.t: Since the silkworm house also served as a theater, the second floor had only a poor sort of audience seating.
Though it was called a second floor, it was very low.

units.source_text: 从这二楼掉落到地面只是一瞬间的事，可是却让人有足够的时间可以用肉眼清楚地捕捉到她落下时的样子。

en.t: Falling from this second floor to the ground took only an instant, yet there seemed to be enough time for the eye to catch clearly the sight of her falling.

units.source_text: 也许这落下时的奇怪样子，就像个玩偶的缘故吧，一看就晓得她已经不省人事了。

en.t: Perhaps because the strange way she fell made her look like a doll, one could tell at a glance that she had already lost consciousness.
She fell without making a sound.

units.source_text: 这地方净是水，没有扬起尘埃。

en.t: The place was all water, so no dust rose.

units.source_text: 正好落在刚蔓延开的火苗和死灰复燃的火苗中间。

en.t: She landed right between the flames that had just spread and the flames flaring up again from dead ashes.
